youtube_title: Service Charge? You DON'T Have to Pay It #Shorts
youtube_description:
Restaurants in India can't force a service charge. CCPA guidelines (4 July 2022) make it voluntary, and the Delhi High Court upheld them on 28 March 2025. Ask them to remove it; if they refuse, complain to the National Consumer Helpline (1915).
Source: CCPA guidelines, 4 Jul 2022; Delhi HC judgment, 28 Mar 2025.
